LanguageData.LP_ProtoplasmGel.label: protoplasm gel
LanguageData.LP_ProtoplasmGel.description: A lump of translucent gel exuded by an oozefolk, cool to the touch and faintly wriggling. Can be made into gel dressings at the alchemy table, or into stabilizing belts for oozefolk at the tailoring bench.\n\nProduced by the oozefolk "exude gel" ability; butchering an oozefolk corpse also yields 3 (no meat or leather). Black Network caravans occasionally sell it.
LanguageData.LP_GelDressing.label: gel dressing
LanguageData.LP_GelDressing.description: Cloth strips soaked in protoplasm gel. Applied to a wound, they adhere and tighten by themselves, close to industrial medicine in effect.
LanguageData.LP_StabilizerBand.label: stabilizing belt
LanguageData.LP_StabilizerBand.description: A leather belt sewn with a few pouches of protoplasm gel, cinched tight around an oozefolk's body so it keeps its shape even in the cold. Only works for oozefolk: the congealing threshold drops from 0°C to -15°C, max protoplasm +20. Worn in the trinket slot, taking no other gear slot.
